facts.business: Landmarc Leisure Corporation Limited operates in the packaged bottle business and motion pictures business.

auditor.name: S K H D & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) Interest-free loans of Rs. 455.87 Lakhs without regularized term sheets impacting loss and loans per Ind AS 109; (ii) Non-provision for ECL on doubtful advances/deposits of Rs. 2,218.28 Lakhs to a party under IBC resolution, overstating advances and understating loss; (iii) Non-provision for ECL on security deposit of Rs. 1,500 Lakhs to a company in liquidation, overstating deposit and understating loss; (iv) Non-compliance with Ind AS 15 for gratuity provision based on management estimates instead of actuarial valuation, shortfall unascertainable.

key_risks: Non-provision for Expected Credit Loss on doubtful advances and deposits
Non-compliance with Ind AS 15 for employee benefits
Advances to parties under insolvency/liquidation proceedings
